name: Lena Hierzi
description: Lena Hierzi is DevRel Lead at Celo Core Co, based in Lisbon. She leads a global developer relations team that accelerates cross-border payments, and she works on product management for agent infrastructure in the Celo ecosystem, including x402 payments with local stablecoins and ERC-8004 agent identity and reputation. A former hackathon builder with more than 20 wins and about $40k in bounties, she has helped many developers get their first role in Web3, from onboarding to introductions to their first job. She moderates this panel on finding a job in web3
